question: What does the signed-in dashboard at portal.scaleinsights.com look like, and how is its navigation laid out?
probes: Turn on Deep mode so the walkthrough recorder can drive the person's signed-in Chrome at 127.0.0.1:9222
Or have the person provide screenshots of the dashboard and its menus
resolution: The walkthrough recorder drove the signed-in Chrome at 127.0.0.1:9222: the dashboard has a 60px dark icon rail (9 sections: Dashboard, Sales, Products, Restock Forecasting, Keyword Ranking, Ads Insights, Automation, Mass Campaigns, Strategy Experts) that opens into a 300px drawer with names and descriptions over a dimmed page (hamburger on phones), a top bar, a date and product filter, 4 period cards, an optimizer row, a performance chart and a product table with period tabs.
